This is the "publicly disclosed" requirement, and it applies to the Acquisition Proposal trigger.

The termination triggers in that provision are: termination by Parent or the Company pursuant to Section 10.01(b)(i) (the Outside Date trigger) or by Parent pursuant to Section 10.01(c)(ii) (breach of Section 6.03). So the "publicly disclosed" requirement applies to Acquisition Proposal + Outside Date Trigger (D) and to Acquisition Proposal + Breach Trigger (B).

There is no No-Vote/MTC Failure Trigger in this deal (it's a tender offer structure with no stockholder vote condition), so C is not supported.
